name: Viscidus
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/temple-of-ahnqiraj/viscidus.md (Wowhead's 5,329,600 HP is 'Seasonal 40 Player', and he takes 50% reduced damage, so HP here is a clock). ESTIMATES: the room is a 40 yd round pool from prose; three freeze cycles (wiki and Tavern say 3 or 4) of 30 s poison, 15 s frozen and 20 s of globs, with HP stepping 100 to 94, 94 to 70, 70 to 64, 64 to 40, 40 to 34, 34 to 0 across the 195 s model. Melee 800 per 2 s (near the wiki's ~1,000 on a nature-geared tank) plus Volley and Poison Shock is ~635 per second: a 10,000 HP tank lives on passive healing (`healPerSecond` 700 for a ghost or player tank) and is lost inside 30 s if a player healer ignores him (140 per second). Freezing and shattering are the fight but only partly simulate: the real counters (170 to 200 frost hits to freeze, 75 to 100 melee hits to shatter within 15 s) cannot be expressed, because attacks do not count toward anything but the HP clock and no event fires on a hit count. The script runs the cycles on a clock: `frozenSolid` is a 15 s `transition` cast that keeps him still and mute (`cast` blocks melee and movement, and a cast boss is still attackable), and the shatter itself is the end of that phase. A failed shatter, and the slowing at 100 and 150 hits, do not exist. Everyone runs in and swings while he is frozen (a `playerAtSpotBy` for ranged and healers); only the frozen-phase position is checked, not who actually lands the hits. Melee wait outside Poison Shock through each poison phase, the approach the wiki says most guilds use (`skipActivity: 'melee'` keeps that from costing them uptime); the wiki's alternative of high-Nature-Resistance melee staying on him with frost oil is not modelled. The ghost raid's melee dots still flank him through the poison phases, because the engine always keeps them on a grounded boss. Frost Oil, frost wands, Wand of Biting Cold and Rank 1 Frostbolt are tips only. Globs: a shatter is a `submerged` phase (no boss, nothing to melee) with eight `killFirst` adds spawning around the room's edge and crawling to the reform point (`holdSpot`), 16 s `lifetime` standing for the raid's burn (real 16.5 s DBM rejoin timer; real HP per glob 24,416 Wowhead or 10-15k wiki; real count 1 to 20, here always 8 so HP steps are fixed instead of following the kills). Killing more globs does not change the next phase's HP; that is the biggest gap against the real fight, where the number you kill IS the fight's clock. Rejoin is `threatWipe` plus `teleportBossTo` the centre at each poison phase's start. The tank has to be at the reform point and pick him up (the wiki's three post-reform theories are not modelled beyond this). He cannot be taunted (the wiki and viscidus.md say so; no spell or log data was fetched, so that is unverified), so the Taunt button is relabelled Build threat and stands in for building threat fast as he reforms. Volley (1,300 direct every 10 s plus three 250-per-second poison debuffs for 10 s, standing in for 'cleanse every target'), Poison Shock (1,050 within 15 yd every 10 s), and Toxin (telegraphed `hazard` 750 per second, 9 s, one per poison phase; wiki's 30 to 40 s cadence would mostly miss a 30 s phase, so this is an estimate) are live only during the poison phases as the spell data says.

raidSpot.label: Raid: more than 15 yd from him

rangedSpot.label: Ranged: more than 15 yd from him

globRanged.label: Kill the globs as they crawl

boss.looseHint: The boss is on the raid. Rebuild threat

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Hold him in the middle while the frost hits add up. He freezes, shatters, and every glob that survives makes him whole again: be on the reform point before he comes back and build threat the moment he does: he cannot be taunted.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Most raids keep melee out of Poison Shock until he freezes: wait outside its 15 yards through each poison phase and step out of Toxin. When he freezes, run in and hit him with everything: he shatters on number of swings. Then every glob you kill takes 5% off him for good.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Rank 1 Frostbolt or frost wand: only the number of hits matters. Stay out of Poison Shock (15 yards), step out of Toxin, run in and swing when he freezes, and kill globs on the way in.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Poison Bolt Volley every 10 seconds needs cleansing every global. Keep the tank up through the poison phase; the frozen windows are your only breathers.

taunt.label: Build threat
taunt.tip: Viscidus cannot be taunted in the real fight. This button stands in for building threat fast as he reforms.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

dispel.label: Cleanse poison
dispel.tip: Abolish Poison, Cleanse or Poison Cleansing Totem. Removes one Poison Bolt Volley poison.

volley.label: Poison Bolt Volley
volley.tip: Hits everyone in the room, every ten seconds. Poison follows it. Cleanse it.

volleyDot.label: Poison Bolt
volleyDot.tip: A poison ticking 500 every two seconds. Cleanse it.

poisonShock.label: Poison Shock
poisonShock.tip: Fifteen yards around him, every ten seconds or so. Only the tank belongs inside it.

toxin.label: Toxin
toxin.tip: A poison cloud under a random player. Move out; it is bigger than it looks.

frozenSolid.label: Frozen solid
frozenSolid.tip: He is frozen for fifteen seconds. Everyone in the room swings.

shatter.label: Viscidus explodes!
shatter.tip: He shatters. Globs crawl back toward the middle: kill as many as you can before they reach it.

glob.label: Globs of Viscidus
glob.tip: Eight globs crawl to the middle. Each one that dies takes 5% off him.

rejoin.label: Viscidus reforms
rejoin.toast: He reforms: threat wiped. Tank, build threat now!
rejoin.tip: What is left of him comes back together in the middle, with an empty threat table.

expectations.label: Hold him in the middle of the pool
expectations.tip: He reforms in the middle after every shatter. Keep him near it, facing away from the raid.

expectations.label: Stay out of Poison Shock
expectations.tip: More than 15 yards from him the whole poison phase. Frost casters keep hitting him from there.

expectations.label: Wait outside Poison Shock
expectations.tip: Most raids keep melee away from him until he freezes. Fifteen yards out, step out of Toxin, and be ready to run in.

expectations.label: Stay out of Poison Shock
expectations.tip: More than 15 yards from him, and still inside 40 yards of the tank.

expectations.label: Move out of Toxin
expectations.tip: A cloud lands on someone. Step out and keep going: it is bigger than it looks and you will be slowed.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Cleanse the Volley poison
expectations.tip: Every Volley leaves a poison on the raid. Cleanse every global.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Viscidus is fast and his Volley goes on the tank as well. Heal early.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: A tank below half with the next Volley coming is a dead tank.

expectations.label: Run in and swing while he is frozen
expectations.tip: Everyone melees a frozen Viscidus. Fifteen seconds to land enough hits: fastest weapon you have.

expectations.label: Every swing counts: do not stand idle
expectations.tip: He shatters on hit count, not damage. Fast weapons and every swing.

expectations.label: Keep him in place
expectations.tip: He cannot act while he is frozen. Stay on him and swing with everyone.

expectations.label: Run in with the raid
expectations.tip: Everyone swings at a frozen Viscidus, healers too: he shatters on hit count. Nothing is hitting the tank for these seconds.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: He is frozen: a breather before the shatter. Top the tank up now.

phases.name: First shatter
phases.subtitle: Kill as many as you can

expectations.label: Be on the reform point before he comes back
expectations.tip: Every glob that reaches the middle becomes part of him again. The tank waits there for what comes next.

expectations.label: Stay on the globs, not in the middle
expectations.tip: Kill them as they crawl in, on the way, not after they have stacked on the reform point.

expectations.label: Kill as many globs as you can
expectations.tip: Every glob is 5% of his health. Kill more of them and the next cycle starts lower.

expectations.label: Keep swinging on the globs
expectations.tip: There is no boss to wait for: every global goes into a glob.

expectations.label: Back out to your healing spot
expectations.tip: Get out of the middle before he reforms: outside Poison Shock, and inside 40 yards of the tank on the reform point.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Nothing to heal for a moment. Be full when he comes back.

expectations.label: Take him the moment he reforms
expectations.tip: Be on the reform point and hit him as he comes back together. He cannot be taunted, so healers hold back for a few seconds.

threatLostCount.label: Times the boss turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had the boss
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the ground effect before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

debuffSeconds.label: Seconds with a dispellable debuff up

attacksOffPriority.label: Boss attacks while a priority add was alive
attacksOffPriority.tip: Face the add and kill it first. The boss can wait.

poisonShockHits.label: Poison Shocks you stood in
poisonShockHits.tip: Fifteen yards from his edge. Melee wait outside it until he freezes.

cues.notes: Cleanse Volley, build threat when he reforms, heal when the tank drops.

list.label: Build threat when Viscidus turns on the raid
list.tip: He cannot be taunted. The moment he turns, press this and hit him: every second he is on the raid someone is dying.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: The tank is below half health and a big hit is coming. Heal now.

list.label: Dispel it
list.tip: Cleanse Volley poison every global until the raid is clean.

drills.name: Reforming
drills.description: He reforms every 12 s with an empty threat table. Build threat the moment he appears.

drills.name: Toxin footwork
drills.description: A cloud under someone every 8 s. Step out and keep attacking.

drills.name: Kill the globs
drills.description: A glob wave. Kill as many as you can before they reach the middle.

drills.name: Cleanse the Volley
drills.description: Volley every 8 s, three poisons each. Cleanse every global and keep the tank up.
